title: Origin Of Life On Earth
definition: The scientific study of how life emerged spontaneously from non-living inorganic matter on early Earth approximately 3.8 to 4.2 billion years ago, transitioning from chemical evolution to biological evolution.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (GS-1 Geography/Science integration regarding Hadean and Archaean eons, Miller-Urey experiment, Panspermia, hydrothermal vents) and provides interdisciplinary analytical value for Mains GS-3 (Science & Technology, biotechnology, astrobiology).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Origin Of Life On Earth.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Early Earth Atmosphere and Primordial Soup concept
Basic Organic Chemistry of Amino Acids and Nucleic Acids
